text: In equal circles, equal angles stand upon equal circumferences whether they are standing at the center or at the circumference. Let $ABC$ and $DEF$ be equal circles, and within them let $BGC$ and $EHF$ be equal angles at the center, and $BAC$ and $EDF$ (equal angles) at the circumference. I say that circumference $BKC$ is equal to circumference $ELF$.
And since circles $ABC$ and $DEF$ are equal, their radii are equal.
assertion: radii of circles ABC and DEF are equal

text: So the two (straight-lines) $BG$, $GC$ (are) equal to the two (straight-lines) $EH$, $HF$ (respectively).
assertion: BG equals EH and GC equals HF (as radii of equal circles)

spans.label: assertion
spans.text: the two (straight-lines) $BG$, $GC$ (are) equal to the two (straight-lines) $EH$, $HF$ (respectively)

text: And the angle at $G$ (is) equal to the angle at $H$.

spans.label: assertion
spans.text: the angle at $G$ (is) equal to the angle at $H$

text: Thus, the base $BC$ is equal to the base $EF$ [Prop.~1.4].

spans.label: assertion
spans.text: the base $BC$ is equal to the base $EF$

text: And since the angle at $A$ is equal to the (angle) at $D$, the segment $BAC$ is thus similar to the segment $EDF$ [Def.~3.11].
assertion: segment BAC is similar to segment EDF

spans.label: assumption
spans.text: the angle at $A$ is equal to the (angle) at $D$

spans.label: assertion
spans.text: the segment $BAC$ is thus similar to the segment $EDF$

text: And they are on equal straight-lines [$BC$ and $EF$].
assertion: segments BAC and EDF are on equal straight-lines BC and EF

spans.label: assertion
spans.text: they are on equal straight-lines [$BC$ and $EF$]

text: And similar segments of circles on equal straight-lines are equal to one another [Prop.~3.24].
assertion: similar segments on equal straight-lines are equal to one another

spans.label: assertion
spans.text: similar segments of circles on equal straight-lines are equal to one another

text: And the whole circle $ABC$ is also equal to the whole circle $DEF$.

spans.label: assertion
spans.text: the whole circle $ABC$ is also equal to the whole circle $DEF$

text: Thus, the remaining circumference $BKC$ is equal to the (remaining) circumference $ELF$.

spans.label: assertion
spans.text: the remaining circumference $BKC$ is equal to the (remaining) circumference $ELF$

text: Thus, in equal circles, equal angles stand upon equal circumferences, whether they are standing at the center or at the circumference. (Which is) the very thing which it was required to show.
